task_definition.task_description: Check the status of the living room light and get its mesh snapshot, then publish that snapshot to the app with high priority for user_123. After that, look up the lock password for the living room, set the living room light brightness to 75%, and finally create a backup of my iot_configs workspace named iot_status_backup and send me an alert.

user_input.query: Please check the status of the light_living in the living_room and grab its mesh snapshot. I need you to publish that snapshot to the app with high priority for user_123. After that, look up the lock password for the living_room and set the brightness of the light_living to 75%. Finally, create a backup of my iot_configs workspace named iot_status_backup and send me an alert once everything is complete.
